meta.name: freeze
meta.description: Lock file edits to one directory for the session — Edit/Write outside it are blocked, not just warned. Use when debugging to stop accidental edits to unrelated code, or to fence a parallel agent to one module. Triggers "freeze edits", "lock editing scope", "restrict edits to", "only edit this folder", "unfreeze", "lift the freeze".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 锁定编辑范围至一个目录，防止意外修改
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常在调试时不小心改到无关代码
copy.tagline_en: Lock edits to one directory, preventing accidental changes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often accidentally edit unrelated code while debugging.

howto.what: Claude 会限制文件编辑（Edit）和写入（Write）操作只能在您指定的一个目录内进行，尝试编辑目录外的文件会被阻止。状态自动保存，其他会话的冻结会自动清除。注意：记事本编辑和终端写入不受此限制。
howto.when: 当您提到“freeze edits”、“lock editing scope”等关键词，或要求限制编辑范围时触发。需要您指定一个目录。

say.note: 之后Claude只允许编辑./src内的文件。
之后Claude恢复对所有文件的编辑权限。
之后Claude报告是否处于冻结状态及限制的目录。

howto.what_en: Claude will restrict Edit and Write operations to a single directory you specify; edits outside that directory are blocked. The state is saved and automatically cleared from other sessions. Note: NotebookEdit and shell writes are not gated.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "freeze edits", "lock editing scope", or ask to restrict edits to a directory. You need to specify a target directory.

say_en.note: Claude will only allow edits inside ./src.
Claude will allow edits to any file again.
Claude reports if freeze is active and which directory.
